Enabled.Label: Enable Effects
Enabled.Hint: Apply shader effects to this tile.

Shader.Label: Shader
Shader.Hint: The shader effect to apply to this tile.

Intensity.Label: Effect Intensity
Intensity.Hint: The strength of the shader effect.

Color.Label: Effect Color
Color.Hint: The color of the effect. An empty value gives the default color of the selected effect.

Speed.Label: Animation Speed
Speed.Hint: The speed of the effect animation. The value 0 stops the animation.

Scale.Label: Pattern Scale
Scale.Hint: The size of the effect pattern. At 1, one pattern unit is one grid square.

Editor.Title: Effect Editor: Tile {id}
Editor.NoBackground: The scene has no background image.
Editor.CaptureFailed: Cannot load the scene background image. Look at the console for more data.
Editor.VideoNotSupported: Tile FX Painter cannot capture a video background.
Editor.ResetView: Reset View. Use the mouse wheel to zoom. To pan, hold Space and drag, or drag with the middle mouse button.
Editor.BrushHardness: Brush Hardness. A lower value gives a wider feathered edge.
Editor.BrushOpacity: Brush Opacity. One stroke does not go above this value. Paint again to add more.
Editor.ContiguousHint: Select only the pixels that connect to the pixel that you click. Clear this option to select all pixels with a near color.
Editor.PolygonHint: Click to add points. Double-click, press Enter, or click the first point to close. Press Escape to cancel.
Editor.SaveFailed: Cannot save the mask. Look at the console for more data.
Editor.InvalidDirectory: Cannot save the mask. The Mask Directory setting must be a directory in the User Data. Change the setting in the module settings.
Editor.LoadFailed: Cannot load the saved mask "{path}". The editor starts with an empty mask.
Editor.UnsavedContent: The mask has unsaved changes. Close the editor and discard the changes?

MaskDirectory.Name: Mask Directory
MaskDirectory.Hint: The directory in the User Data for the mask files of the Effect Editor. Other sources, for example Core Data and S3, do not work. The default directory stays after a module update. A module update or a reinstall can delete other directories in modules/tile-fx-painter/.
